eva (research): quick note  ran onboarding eval for rerank-lite-int8 on holdout-beta: ndcg@10 +1.2% but mrr@1 -2.3% vs fp16.
liam (ml): same harness/seed?
eva (research): yep: `eval/run.py --model rerank-lite-int8 --set holdout-beta --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 13`
ci-bot: job 115432 finished  results: https://ci.redwood.ai/115432
frank (infra): build used the new asymmetric PTQ and we added a tiny output clamp in the int8 path last week.
june (prod): any recent UI/concat changes? we enable "merge snippets" for a/b last night.
eva (research): replicated with two configs: "separate" (each passage separate candidate) and "merged" (merge top3). flips concentrated in merged. flip-rate top1 merged=6.1%, separate=0.9%.
liam (ml): pattern suggests quantized logits reduce pairwise margins and cause rank inversion. mrr is sensitive to top1 flips while ndcg sometimes benefits if more relevant docs bubble up.
frank (infra): i'll diff kernel changes and try reverting the clamp locally.
eva (research): i sampled a few flip cases; example: 
```
# QID: R987
fp16: A=4.12 (rank1), B=3.78 (rank2)
int8: A=3.95, B=4.01 -> flip
# margin shrank from 0.34 to -0.06
```
liam (ml): try two quick ablations: 1) scale int8 logits by 1.02 and recompute 2) lower softmax temp for int8 path to see stability.
eva (research): scaled 1.02 -> mrr recovers ~+1.9% and keeps ndcg +0.9%. added "flip-rate" metric to harness: scaled flip-rate on merged drops to ~2.1%.
frank (infra): kernel revert queued in staging. also checking if token separators are injected differently during merging.
june (prod): operationally if scale fixes it we can gate rollout on a per-model multiplier knob. please document the hotpatch steps in ops runbook and add a monitor on flip-rate and top1-rates.
liam (ml): will add a tiny CI probe that computes flip-rate between fp16 and int8 on a small seed nightly.
eva (research): logging the example ids to s3 for manual review. will post a summary tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
